title: Sirf Tum
desc: Deepak and Aarti fall in love through letters without ever meeting or knowing each other's address. Longing to see him, Aarti finally travels to Delhi to search for her true love.

title: Tezaab
desc: After his parents' murder, Mahesh is imprisoned and separated from Mohini, who suffers under her cruel father. Years later, he returns to rescue her and avenge his past.

title: Khiladiyon Ka Khiladi
desc: Akshay joins Maya's gang while searching for his missing brother. To earn her trust, he must prove his strength and defeat his rival in a wrestling match.

title: Gangaajal
desc: IPS Amit Kumar, an honest cop, is posted to a crime-ridden town. He battles ruthless criminals, crooked officers, and shady politicians to restore law and justice.

title: Akhanda 2: Thaandavam
desc: As biological warfare threatens the country, a scientist seeks a cure. But when dangerous forces target her, a warrior returns to defend humanity.

title: Dhaakad
desc: Agent Agni reluctantly accepts a mission to capture Rudraveer, a dangerous trafficker. Her journey takes unexpected turns, pushing her into uncharted paths filled with risk and discovery.

title: 14 Phere
desc: Sanjay and Aditi, from different castes, fall in love and decide to marry. Knowing their parents will oppose, they devise a plan to win their approval and unite their families.

title: Chaalbaaz
desc: Separated twins Anju and Manju grow up differently and accidentally swap lives. Shy Anju enters a rustic world, while bold Manju bravely takes revenge on their evil uncle.

title: Haq
desc: In 1980s India, Shazia Bano fights for child support, but her husband's attempt to silence her through triple talaq sparks a nationwide debate on women's rights.

title: Taal
desc: Mansi rises to fame with Vikrant's help after being insulted. But when her ex apologises and wants her back, she must choose between past pain and present success.

title: Hero No. 1
desc: A rich businessman hides his identity and pretends to be Raju, happily doing household chores. His skills and charm help him win over his girlfriend's family, all for love.

title: Love, Sex Aur Dhokha 2
desc: Three interconnected tales follow different people navigating the murky waters of human intimacy, sexual discovery, personal identity, and modern romance inside a hyper-connected, digital world.

title: Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan
desc: Bhaijaan, the eldest brother, stays unmarried to keep peace in the family. But things get complicated when his younger brothers secretly try to make him fall in love.

title: Aa Ab Laut Chalen
desc: Rohan Khanna moves to the US for work and finds himself torn between Pooja and Loveleen. Eventually, he realises his heart belongs to Pooja and returns to her.
